The issuer shows solid profitability (net income margin ~19% based on 403M vs. 2,106M revenue), but leverage is high with liabilities of 17,381M against assets of 21,779M (liabilities/assets ~80%) and relatively thin capitalization (equity/assets ~15%). With limited balance-sheet cushion implied by these ratios, the credit profile aligns with the lower investment-grade boundary or speculative grade—closer to the latter given the leverage.  

DECISION: BB-
